duties.duty: Applies to providers that "offer services in the Union", i.e. with a "substantial connection" (establishment, "significant number of recipients", or "targeting of activities"); "mere technical accessibility ... cannot, on that ground alone" establish it. Hosting = storage of information "provided by, and at the request of, a recipient"; online platform = a hosting service that also disseminates it to the public.
duties.reason: Reasoned view: likely outside. (1) An information society service must be "normally provided for remuneration" (Directive 2015/1535 Art 1(1)(b), not in the file); an unpaid, non-commercial personal project may not be one. (2) No EU establishment; recipients are few; no currency, no EU top-level domain, no app, no ads; English and Japanese serve researchers worldwide rather than targeting a Member State. On the policies' own worst-case stance (takedown.md:91) Sophaxis is a hosting service (PDF copies, abstracts, statements and reasons stored at authors' request) and an online platform (record pages disseminated to the public), and a micro enterprise if an enterprise at all: DSA Art 15(1) is lifted by Art 15(2), and Section 3 of Chapter III (Arts 20-28) except Art 24(3) by Art 19 (not in the file). Arts 11-18 bind; the rows below judge them on that stance.

duties.reason: 受信箱：日本に住む利用者に iCloud を提供するのは、iCloud 利用規約によれば日本の会社 iTunes 株式会社で、ガイドライン（外国にある第三者への提供編）は第三者を法人格で判断するので、外国にある第三者への提供ではない。委託（個人情報保護法第27条第5項第一号）として個人情報保護法第25条で監督し、米国の Apple Inc. が取り扱うことは Q&A 10-24 に沿って安全管理措置と公表事項に入れた。Vercel の記録：Sophaxis は IP アドレスを人に結びつけるものを持たず、照合には他の事業者への照会が要るので、通則編の読み方で Sophaxis にとって個人情報ではなく、個人情報保護法第28条が定める個人データではない。Vercel は要求を読者から直に受け、Sophaxis は記録から何も渡さない。2026-11-12 に取り寄せた文（verification/sources-raw.json の pages）による。
